brief: US-Canada trade tensions escalate as Canada halts talks; Tropical Storm Moke threatens Hawaii; AI and humanoid robotics advance, including a robot beating Bolt's 100m record. Research highlights surgical AI, visualization education, and smart home privacy.
news_summary: Canada's PM Carney walks away from US trade talks, vowing retaliation amid tariffs; a US judge deems visa ban illegal; Tropical Storm Moke nears Hawaii; and a humanoid robot sets a new 100m record.
papers_summary: Papers cover AI-assisted surgery, documentation for coding agents, visualization concept inventories, smart home privacy, and robot voice pitch effects on children.

zh.brief: 今日国际焦点集中在美加贸易谈判破裂及加拿大总理卡尼的强硬回应，同时美国国内政治与王室新闻也引人关注。科研方面，AI在手术识别、编码助手中的应用研究成为亮点。
zh.news_summary: 美加贸易谈判破裂，加拿大总理卡尼称特朗普关税是“误判”并宣布报复性关税；美国法官裁定特朗普政府针对75国的签证禁令非法；热带风暴Moke袭击夏威夷；哈里和梅根的王室事业受挫。
zh.papers_summary: 论文涉及AI在食管手术中识别喉返神经的研究，以及编码代理如何阅读技术文档的实证研究，揭示AI辅助开发的潜力与挑战。
